# Stash cleanup manifest — 2026-08-05

All 115 stashes across the parent and five submodules were triaged by CONTENT
against `origin/development` and then dropped. This file records every stash
SHA so the cleanup is reversible: a dropped stash stays reachable by SHA until
git prunes unreachable objects (`gc.pruneExpire`, 2 weeks by default).

Recover one with: `git -C <repo> stash apply <sha>` or `git show <sha>`.
